notes: FOUR-branch candidate for the L^2 framework of c1-t4 T4-019 (c1-coord request 21:34Z). Exact linear constraints (101 rows): center; Theta_0 (10); leading moments of branches 1,2,3 for all m <= 10j+9 equal to the exact stationary potentials C_1, C_2, C_3 (90). No descendant constraints (not needed when only exponents >= -1 are forbidden). EXACT sector table: (1,0), (2,0), (3,0) EXACT-ZERO (all harmonics); first surviving sector (4,0) at exponent -1.2381 with quarter norm 172.84 (the invariant of the four-branch family; it has exponent < -1 so F is in L^2); then (0,1) 2464.9, (5,0) 131.4, (1,1) 48870, (6,0) 289.2, (2,1) 3.42e5, ... (large unconstrained descendants: the optimizer uses them as mid-field freedom). FLOAT (midpoint 80, 0.02 <= r <= 1e4): P2 = 7310.5, G1 = 177.3, G0 = 252.2, rF = 6.28e5, sup|F| = 11.04. G0 is at the four-branch L^2 floor: the (4,0) sector alone gives ||F||_{L^2(r>R)} = 501 R^(-0.238) (exact formula), i.e. 290 from R = 10 on. ANSWER to the request: exact cancellation of (1,0),(2,0),(3,0) with all harmonics is feasible (60 extra blocks, here 240 generators), but the L^2 framework then has a residual floor of order 10^2 from the (4,0) sector; it needs the same enlarged branch structure as the E_2 framework (see numerics_v01 section 3 for the floors with N branches). NOT a closure candidate.
